statement: A text page whose only drawing is a small group at the bottom left: a nude human figure lying diagonally (head raised at upper right, legs toward lower left, one arm bent down to the ground), two small circles to its left (one plain, one with an irregular edge), a short open-topped cylinder with a dotted rim and ochre wash, and a few small words in a different script beside the circles (not read). One line of Voynich text sits directly above the figure; it is the folio's only Lx label line, f66r.82, given to the figure. The left-margin label lines f66r.1-49 are a column of single words and a column of single characters beside the text lines and point at no drawing. Faint green show-through of a plant from the other side of the leaf is visible behind the text and is not counted.
